## What's Changed

> [!CAUTION]
**Version 26.3 is the final release supporting legacy architectures and older OS baselines**:
>* Linux MIPS (`mipseb`, `mipsel`)
>* Linux PowerPC e500 (`ppc500`)
>* Linux kernel < 3.2 (Kernel 2.6.x series is now deprecated)

  - Features:
    - Added support for extension i18n [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/872](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/872)
    - Added per-feed certificate verification option [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/846](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/846)
    - Updated 7-Zip to 26.02 and UnRAR to 7.23 [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/847](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/847)

  - Bug fixes:
    - Fixed missing path separator in auto-detected config template path [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/902](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/902)
    - Fixed feed preview for new (unsaved) feeds [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/893](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/893)
    - Fixed RSS episode duplicate keys [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/868](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/868)
    - Hardened web auth token generation and unpack-dir symlink handling [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/894](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/894)
    - Fixed WebUI crash on startup with non-English languages [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/845](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/845)
    - Fixed WebUI runtime errors from unguarded addEventListener and Status.status accesses [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/834](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/834)
    - Fixed feed category priority and consolidated category resolution [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/835](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/835)
    - Fixed JSON-RPC param reader [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/843](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/843)
    - Fixed category not preserved for compressed archives in NzbDir subdirectories [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/860](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/860)
    - Fixed SkipWrite causing an infinite spin loop [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/871](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/871)
    - Fixed "Download Remaining Files" not working for Health-failed files from History [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/870](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/870)
    - Fixed UnpackPassFile not being consulted for 7z archives with encrypted headers [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/877](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/877)
    - Fixed parsing of the filename from the Content-Disposition header [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/865](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/865)
    - Fixed error message for OS release retrieval on Linux [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/864](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/864)
    - Fixed segfault crashes and data races [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/851](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/851)
    - Fixed printf format specifiers for int64 and size_t [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/856](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/856)
    - Translated leftover English strings in Polish and Hungarian locale files [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/876](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/876)
    - Updated DirectUnpack description and WriteLog default value [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/837](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/837)

  - For developers:
    - Added AI-Assisted Contributions Policy [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/873](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/873)
    - Bumped par2-turbo to v1.4.0-20260803 [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/885](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/885)
    - Updated rapidyenc to v1.1.1-20260821 [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/896](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/896)
    - Fixed functional test suite on Python 3 and modern pytest [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/883](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/883)
    - Fixed rare random failures in System tests [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/859](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/859)
    - Fixed tests skipping without assertions when unrar/7z unavailable [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/878](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/878)
    - Fixed cppcheck errors in CI and added .clang-tidy / .clangd configs for consistent static analysis [https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/811](https://github.com/nzbgetcom/nzbget/pull/811)
